prompt: Implement dependency-aware execution in run_plan.sh and plan.sh. CLI: `bash run_plan.sh PLAN JOBS RESULTS`. PLAN is a UTF-8 TSV file with exactly three nonempty fields per line: job_id, dependencies, script_path. IDs match [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31} and are unique. Dependencies are '-' for none or a comma-separated list of distinct existing IDs (forward references allowed). Scripts are regular non-symlink files relative to JOBS, with no absolute path, empty, . or .. path components. Spaces, Unicode, glob characters and leading dashes are allowed in script paths; tabs/newlines are not. Empty plans are valid; final LF is optional. JOBS is an existing directory. RESULTS must be absent (parent exists) or an empty directory. Before executing ANY job or creating/changing RESULTS, validate the whole plan, all script paths, dependencies, duplicate dependencies, and absence of dependency cycles. Wrong arguments or invalid inputs exit 2, diagnostic stderr and no stdout, no job execution or results changes. Execute sequentially in topological order, selecting the earliest PLAN row among ready unprocessed jobs. Run each script with bash, cwd JOBS, stdin /dev/null. Redirect its stdout/stderr bytes to RESULTS/ID.out and ID.err. A nonzero exit must not abort independent jobs: a job with any failed/blocked dependency is blocked (not executed, no logs). Successful jobs have state succeeded, nonzero jobs failed, others blocked. Write RESULTS/status.tsv in original PLAN order as `ID<TAB>STATE<TAB>EXIT_CODE<LF>`, where EXIT_CODE is actual bash status for executed jobs and '-' for blocked. Empty plan produces empty status.tsv. Exit 0 if every job succeeds, 1 if any failed/blocked. No runner stdout on valid runs. Preserve strict bash mode. Filesystem writes succeed; jobs do not modify the plan, runner, JOBS or RESULTS, but may append to an external trace to observe order. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
